advertisements.description:
The Municipality of Titay Joins Arbor Day 2026 🌱
Today, we planted not just trees, but hope for a greener and more sustainable future for the next generations. My sincere gratitude to our Honorable Governor Ann K. Hofer for spearheading this meaningful cause of preserving our environment and protecting our future.
I likewise extend my heartfelt appreciation to Congresswoman Doc Marly Hofer T. Hasim for gracing this activity with her presence and unwavering support. Hapi ug dasig kanunay sa Distrito Dos!
To our LMP President, Mayor Katrina Balladares of Kabasalan, and the rest of my fellow mayors Zamboanga Sibugay, our LGU Titay Family our MaDASIGong department heads, PNP, BFP, barangay officials, and everyone who joined us today, daghang salamat for your commitment to environmental stewardship.
Together, let us continue planting seeds of change and nurturing a greener, stronger, and more resilient Titay and Sibugay!🌳❤️
DASIG TITAY, LAMBO PA SIBUGAY!🤍
#DASIGTITAY

advertisements.description:
𝙏𝙊𝙐𝙍 𝙂𝙐𝙄𝘿𝙄𝙉𝙂 101: Training and Orientation on Cave Rescue at the Matilum Cave Complex
As part of the Municipality of Titay’s continued efforts to promote safe and sustainable tourism, the LGU proudly joined the Community Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) in the conduct of the Training and Orientation on Cave Rescue at the Matilum Cave Complex.
Participants gained valuable knowledge and skills in cave rescue operations and Tour Guiding 101, helping strengthen local tourism services and visitor safety.
Special thanks to Mayor DONRIO Martinez Castillo for the unwavering support in initiatives that enhance the capabilities of our tourism stakeholders and promote responsible tourism in Titay.

newsArticles.summary:
𝐄𝐌𝐄𝐑𝐆𝐄𝐍𝐂𝐘 𝐌𝐄𝐃𝐈𝐂𝐀𝐋 𝐑𝐄𝐒𝐏𝐎𝐍𝐒𝐄 
𝐈𝐍 𝐏𝐇𝐎𝐓𝐎𝐒 || Titay Municipal Fire Station Shift A duty personnel received a report from a concerned citizen requesting an emergency medical response in Poblacion, Titay, Zamboanga Sibugay. In response, Titay MFS Shift A personnel immediately proceeded to the reported location to render appropriate emergency medical assistance.  Upon arrival at the scene, the responding team conducted a primary assessment, including an evaluation of the patient's level of consciousness, presence of bleeding, and possible injuries. The patient was found conscious, alert, and oriented, and was seated in the corner of the classroom. Assessment revealed a suspected fracture of the left knee.  Immediate first aid was rendered by applying a splint to the suspected fracture to immobilize the affected left knee and help prevent further injury during transport.  The patient was immediately transported to De Villa Hospital for further medical evaluation and management.    
 𝐈𝐍 𝐂𝐀𝐒𝐄 𝐎𝐅 𝐄𝐌𝐄𝐑𝐆𝐄𝐍𝐂𝐘, call 911 or contact the Titay MFS Hotline Number: 0965-509-0944.

newsArticles.title: FO1 Carido Brings World-Class Emergency Care Home
newsArticles.summary:
FO1 Carido Brings World-Class Emergency Care Home
Titay Municipal Fire Station celebrates another milestone as FO1 Arven T Carido successfully completed the prestigious Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) and Tactical Emergency Casualty Care (TECC) Training Program in Taiwan from June 22–30, 2026.
FO1 Carido was among only 54 BFP emergency responders nationwide selected for the international training. The program equipped participants with advanced skills in tactical emergency medicine, pre-hospital care, disaster response, and high-risk rescue operations.
His achievement is a source of pride for Titay MFS, as the knowledge and expertise he gained will further strengthen the station's emergency medical response capabilities, ensuring faster, safer, and more effective life-saving services for the people of Titay. Through this international learning experience, Titay MFS continues its commitment to delivering emergency response that meets global standards while serving the local community with excellence.
